title: Constitutional Coherence Tree
description: A binary tree of constitutional principles centered on coherence.

root.label: Coherence
root.summary: The constitution holds its principles together through balanced rights and duties.

children.label: Freedom
children.summary: Freedom protects the individual's space to think, speak, believe, and act.

children.label: Expression
children.summary: Speech, writing, art, and conscience allow public reasoning and dissent.

children.label: Press
children.summary: Independent media supports scrutiny and circulation of ideas.

children.label: Belief
children.summary: Freedom of conscience protects religion, conviction, and non-belief.

children.label: Association
children.summary: People must be free to gather, organize, and participate together.

children.label: Assembly
children.summary: Peaceful gathering is essential for protest, debate, and solidarity.

children.label: Petition
children.summary: Collective demands connect citizens to institutions.

children.label: Responsibility
children.summary: Constitutional order relies on fairness, limits on power, and civic reciprocity.

children.label: Equality
children.summary: Equal dignity and equal treatment keep liberty from becoming privilege.

children.label: Inclusion
children.summary: Institutions should protect minorities and widen equal access.

children.label: Non-Discrimination
children.summary: No one should be excluded from rights because of identity or status.

children.label: Justice
children.summary: Public power must be lawful, reviewable, and answerable to the people.

children.label: Privacy
children.summary: Personal autonomy and due process place limits on state intrusion.

children.label: Participation
children.summary: Voting, representation, and accountability sustain legitimate government.
